question: Who is the author of ‘The Inheritance of Loss’?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Kiran Desai.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ​The** second book** written by Indian novelist **Kiran Desai** is titled The** Inheritance of Loss.**
 
• It was initially released in** 2006.**
 
• It earned the **Vodafone Crossword Book Award** in **2006 **and the **National Book Critics Circle Fiction Award** in **2007.**
 
• It also won the Booker
